description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called SettingsFragment, which represents a settings screen in a mobile app. It displays various settings options such as profile, favorites, language, shortcuts, about, subscribe to beta, and logout, with corresponding navigation and dialog handling.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders a settings menu with multiple options and controls navigation to other screens like language selection and logout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the ListView containing settings options, managing language preference display, and handling navigation and logout dialog.

methods.name: _buildSettingsItem
methods.description: Helper method to create individual settings list items with icon, title, optional subtitle, trailing widget, and tap callback.

methods.name: _showLogoutDialog
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog for logout, clears preferences, and navigates to OTP validation screen on confirmation.
